# Shroom

> Shroom is a browser-based video calling application for starting or joining focused meetings without downloading an app.

Shroom runs at https://shroom.call/. A visitor can choose a display name, start a new room, or join an existing room from a shared link or room code. Shared links always stop at a pre-join device screen before microphone or camera access is enabled. Refreshes and temporary network reconnects can resume an active room without repeating pre-join.

## Product

- [Shroom home](https://shroom.call/): Start a room or join from a link.
- [Sitemap](https://shroom.call/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs.

## Capabilities

- Browser-based video and audio calls using WebRTC.
- Shareable room links and room codes.
- Microphone, camera, and device confirmation before first entry.
- Optional end-to-end media encryption when supported by the browser and room.
- Network reconnection, device recovery, captions, reactions, hand raising, and local recording controls.

## Important behavior

- A newly opened room link does not bypass the pre-join privacy screen.
- An already active room may reconnect after a refresh or temporary network failure.
- Room URLs and the administration interface are private application routes and are not intended for search indexing.

## Contact and attribution

- Product name: Shroom
- Canonical URL: https://shroom.call/
